description.value:
You grew up far from durasteel cities and comm towers, out where herds migrate across whole horizons and the nearest settlement is a rumor. Whether you lived as a wanderer, a hunter-gatherer, a recluse, or something closer to a raider, the wilds shaped you more than any city ever could.

Even on a world you've never set foot on, you know how to read weather, track game, and find water — the wild speaks a language you never had to be taught.

system.equipment: A walking stick, a hunting trap, a trophy from an animal you killed, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 100 credits.
